# Yasser Ahmad Raafat — Agentic AI & RAG Systems Engineer

> Cairo-based senior AI engineer who designs and builds production agentic AI and RAG systems:

## Summary
Yasser Raafat builds production-grade autonomous agent and RAG systems end to end. He architected and
built CoreFusion — a full autonomous agent developer platform (sandboxed agent runtime, Book-RAG code
intelligence, an RBAC-scoped memory plane, a runtime MCP integration layer, and a payments/LMS
ecosystem) — solo, as independent R&D. The codebase and its ~1,110 tests (853 Python + 257 Vitest)
exist; it was not publicly deployed. Proof is a code walkthrough, not a live demo URL.

## What he does (services)
- Production RAG systems: hybrid dense+sparse retrieval, RRF fusion, reranking, pgvector.
- Agent orchestration: tool/function calling, guardrails, MCP server integration.
- Evaluation: SWE-bench-caliber eval harnesses, red-teaming, RLHF/DPO/SFT data design.
- Delivery: "The Production RAG Sprint" — scope, build, eval-gate, handoff. Pricing shared on contact.
